name: Jowar Vegetable Upma
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ½ tsp each mustard seeds and urad dal
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
steps: Dry-roast the jowar rava for 3 minutes until fragrant. Set aside.
Heat the oil, crackle the mustard, and fry the urad dal until golden. Add chilli, ginger and curry leaves.
Add the onion and vegetables and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the water and salt and bring to a boil. Pour in the rava slowly, stirring.
Add the crumbled tofu with the vegetables.
Cover and cook on low for 8 minutes. Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
note: A gluten-free alternative to rava upma, with more fibre.
